About us

A software engineering company built around the work.

Coastline Digital is a software engineering and AI consulting company based in San Diego, CA. We help companies design, build, and modernize the software their business depends on.

Company background

Engineering partner to product teams, businesses, and consultancies.

Coastline Digital is based in San Diego, CA, and works with companies on custom software, AI and machine learning, cloud and data engineering, and enterprise modernization.

We serve startups and SaaS companies building their core products, growing and established businesses modernizing how they operate, and software consulting firms that need a dependable engineering delivery partner for their own clients.

Our engagements take three forms: dedicated engineering teams, project-based delivery, and engineering delivery partnerships. Each is structured around clear ownership, visible progress, and software that your team can maintain long after the first release.

Engineering philosophy

Principles that guide how we build.

  1. 01

    Understand before building

    We learn how the work actually happens and what success means to the business before writing significant code.

  2. 02

    Small, reviewable increments

    Frequent, demonstrable progress keeps risk low and gives you real control over direction.

  3. 03

    Maintainability is a feature

    Clear structure, tests, and documentation matter as much as the first release, because most software lives for years.

  4. 04

    Practical over fashionable

    We choose established, well-supported approaches unless a newer one clearly serves your goals.

  5. 05

    Candid communication

    We raise risks early, explain trade-offs in plain language, and say so when something is not working.

Collaboration approach

We work with your team, not around it.

The best results come from close collaboration with the people who know the business. We join your planning, share our work early, and make decisions visible.

What collaboration looks like

  • Direct access to the engineers doing the work
  • Shared repositories, backlogs, and documentation
  • Regular demos of working software
  • Written status updates covering progress, decisions, and risks
  • Work in your tools and processes wherever practical

Distributed team model

Based in San Diego. International engineering team.

Coastline Digital is based in San Diego, CA, and we work with an international team of experienced engineering professionals. That lets us match the right skills to each engagement rather than limiting ourselves to a single location.

Distributed delivery only works when it is transparent. For every engagement, we tell you who is working on your project, where they are located, and how their working hours overlap with your team. Communication cadence, documentation, and access are agreed at kickoff.
